decks.notes: This aggressive deck focuses on using the two partner commanders, Ellie, Brick Master and Ellie, Vengeful Hunter, to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of low-cost creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to apply early pressure with efficient creatures like Bloodsoaked Champion and Dread Wanderer, while also utilizing removal spells such as Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt to control the board. With a mix of aggressive creatures, burn spells, and disruption, this deck can quickly deal damage and disrupt the opponent's game plan, ultimately aiming to win through combat damage or direct burn spells. The deck is built to be fast, punishing opponents who stumble or take too long to set up their own game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing the powerful abilities of the Toph, Greatest Earthbender commander to create a fast and aggressive strategy. By including cards that ramp mana, such as Birds of Paradise and Elvish Mystic, the deck aims to quickly play out threats like Berserk and Bonecrusher Giant to overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Earthbender Ascension and Bumi, Unleashed further enhances the deck's aggro strategy by providing additional ways to deal damage and control the board. With cards like Lightning Bolt and Pyrokinesis for removal, the deck seeks to maintain pressure on the opponent while utilizing the commander's abilities to disrupt their game plan and secure victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing Ketramose, the New Dawn as the commander to aggressively control the battlefield and disrupt the opponent's strategy. It includes a variety of removal spells like Fatal Push, Swords to Plowshares, and Murderous Cut to eliminate threats efficiently. The deck also features cards like Council's Judgment, Opposition Agent, and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's plans and maintain board control. With cards such as Sanctifier en-Vec and Skyclave Apparition, the deck can handle opposing threats while advancing its own strategy. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply early pressure, disrupt the opponent's game plan, and maintain control of the battlefield to secure a victory in a Duel Commander 1 vs 1 format.

This deck revolves around using Aang, Swift Savior as the commander to lead an aggressive strategy in a Duel Commander 1 vs 1 format. The deck includes a mix of control elements like Counterspell and Mana Leak as well as disruptive creatures like Glacial Fortress and Brazen Borrower. The main focus is on tempo advantage, using cards like Daze and Force Spike to counter opponents' plays while deploying threats like Captain Marvel, Earth's Protector and Malcolm, Alluring Scoundrel to pressure opponents early on. The deck also includes efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Skyclave Apparition to deal with opposing threats, ensuring that the aggressive game plan can remain on track.

The deck focuses on utilizing aggressive strategies with a variety of powerful creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm opponents in a one-on-one Duel Commander format. It includes a mix of efficient removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Collective Brutality, along with powerful reanimation options such as Animate Dead and Necromancy to bring back key threats. The deck also features powerful commanders like Terra, Magical Adept and Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant to lead the assault. With a strong mix of removal, disruption, and powerful threats, the deck aims to put pressure on opponents early and maintain a dominant position throughout the game.

The deck revolves around assembling a strong board presence and controlling the opponent's resources through a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells. Kellogg, Dangerous Mind serves as the commander, providing card advantage and a powerful ability to pressure the opponent. The deck includes a mix of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push, disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, and powerful creatures like Goldspan Dragon and Super Shredder. By applying early pressure and disrupting the opponent's game plan, the deck aims to control the tempo of the game and emerge victorious through a mix of aggressive attacks and strategic plays.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Aggro archetype with Amalia Benavides Aguirre as the commander. The deck includes a variety of creatures, spells, and lands to quickly bring out strong creatures and overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds additional value by allowing certain cards to be played from the graveyard. The deck focuses on dealing damage quickly and efficiently through a combination of creature abilities, equipment like Shadowspear, and spells like Swords to Plowshares. With a strong mana base and a mix of aggressive creatures and supporting spells, this deck aims to dominate the battlefield and defeat the opponent swiftly.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with the use of two Partner commanders. It includes a variety of low-cost creatures and spells to quickly pressure the opponent and maintain a fast pace throughout the game. The deck also utilizes a mix of synergy between cards to create powerful combos and efficient ways to deal damage. With a strong mana base and access to versatile cards like Demonic Tutor and Tainted Pact, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early on and maintain control of the battlefield. By combining both red and black cards, it offers a diverse range of threats and removal options to adapt to different matchups and situations.
